verifications.claim: WrestleMania 42 (2026) is scheduled on Saturday, April 18, 2026 and Sunday, April 19, 2026.

verifications.evidence: R1: '6 p.m. ET on Saturday, April 18'; R2: 'Night 2 on Sunday Date: April 19, 2026'; R3: 'WrestleMania 42 Night 2 will be held April 19'; R4: 'Night 1 on April 18 ... Night 2 on April 19'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the exact dates for both nights of WrestleMania 42.

verifications.claim: WrestleMania 42 (2026) is scheduled to end around 9 p.m. ET (6 p.m. PT / 8 p.m. CT) on both Saturday, April 18, 2026 and Sunday, April 19, 2026.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R1: 'projected end time at around 9 p.m. ET (8 p.m. CT / 6 p.m. PT)' for Saturday (three hours); R3: 'expected WrestleMania will last about four hours each night' (implying ~10 p.m. ET end)
verifications.reasoning: R1 supports exact times for Saturday, but R3 indicates four hours for both nights, contradicting a 9 p.m. ET end.
